criteria.criterion: Given a user is viewing Voice Call, MS Teams Call, Data Speed, Service, Video Streaming, Browsing, FTP, SMS or Email, when the report loads, then an Export action is available.
criteria.blocker: Inspection stopped before any supported report view was opened.

criteria.criterion: Given a user is viewing Overview, when the report loads, then an Export action is not available.
criteria.blocker: Inspection stopped before the Overview report view was opened.

criteria.criterion: Given a user selects Export from a supported view, when the export completes, then an Excel file containing that view's export data is downloaded.
criteria.blocker: No Export action was executed before the stop instruction.

criteria.criterion: Given a user changes the Beacon or date range, when they export a supported view, then the generated file reflects the current Beacon and selected range.
criteria.blocker: No Beacon/date-range change and export file inspection were completed before the stop instruction.

criteria.criterion: Given the file is downloaded, when its filename is generated, then it identifies the report type and export date.
criteria.blocker: No export file was downloaded before the stop instruction.

criteria.criterion: Given export data is unavailable or the request fails, when the user attempts an export, then the standard error or empty response is shown without exposing data outside their existing access.
criteria.blocker: No unavailable-data or failed-export condition was reached before the stop instruction.

inspectionNotes: V4 GIS was available in an existing authenticated browser session.
The Beacons layer and list panel were visible, and the All list could be populated.
The report/export workflow was not reached before the bounded-run stop instruction.
evidenceLimitations: Live browser screenshots were captured during the run, but PNG files could not be persisted to the repository from this execution environment.
Committed evidence is redacted to avoid exposing internal Beacon identifiers or authenticated application details.
